title: pseudotsuga menziesii subsp. glaucescens
intro: Pseudotsuga menziesii subsp. glaucescens, commonly known as Rocky Mountain Douglas Fir, is a subspecies of coniferous tree native to the western United States. The essential oil extracted from its leaves and needles has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Pseudotsuga menziesii subsp. glaucescens include terpenes such as bornyl acetate, bornene, and pinene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
